info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Compliance API
info.description: The Operational Actions Compliance API facilitates the management of compliance-related operational actions within the banking sector. This endpoint allows financial institutions to execute and manage specific compliance tasks critical to adhering to regulatory standards. Typical use cases include the submission of compliance reports, audit logs, and operational guidelines. Designed for compliance officers and banking administrators, this API streamlines the alignment of operational actions with established compliance frameworks.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for guideline compliance.
post.description: This operation allows users to create a new operational action related to compliance guidelines. It expects the necessary details of the action in the request body and processes it to ensure alignment with compliance standards.
